## Transferable Commercial & Operations Background (2015 – 2025)

Before transitioning into software engineering, Evelyn led independent commercial and architectural retail design projects (2015–2019) and founded and operated an international e-commerce brand serving customers across 15+ countries (2020–2025). This background translates directly into software engineering strengths:
- **Stakeholder Requirement Discovery**: Translating client and business needs into clear technical specifications before writing code.
- **Cross-Functional Coordination**: Aligning multidisciplinary contributors and end users to deliver projects on schedule.
- **End-to-End Ownership**: Managing full product lifecycles, international customer operations, and tight delivery deadlines.

## Core Software Projects

### 1. Lumina Eventos (Full-Stack Event Venue Rental Platform)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/elynzx/alquiler-eventos-frontend
- **Domain**: Full-Stack Event Venue & Furniture Reservation Platform
- **Stack**: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security (JWT), MySQL, React, TypeScript, Zustand, React Hook Form, Tailwind CSS, Cloudinary
- **Summary**: Full-stack platform for booking event venues and furniture. Implemented role-based JWT authentication (`CLIENTE` and `ADMIN`), multi-criteria venue filtering, PDF booking receipts, an admin CRUD dashboard, and a modular React frontend structured under Atomic Design with Zustand global state.

### 2. PawGuard (Pet Insurance & Care Management Platform)
- **Domain**: Full-Stack Web Application / Pet Insurance & Veterinary Care Management
- **Stack**: React, TypeScript, Supabase, Java, Spring Boot (In Migration)
- **Summary**: Web application simplifying pet insurance comparison, policy management, and veterinary care tracking, migrating backend services to a dedicated Java and Spring Boot REST API.

### 3. Siro Plan (Kanban Task & Subtask Workspace)
- **Live URL**: https://siroplan.pages.dev/
- **Domain**: Productivity Workspace for Students & Young Professionals
- **Stack**: Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), CSS3, Cloudflare Pages, Java & Spring Boot (Next Phase)
- **Summary**: Kanban task and subtask management workspace with an integrated Pomodoro focus timer, engineered with modular ES6 state management and deployed on Cloudflare Pages while building its Spring Boot persistence backend.

### 4. Raíces del Valle (Collaborative Regional E-Commerce Platform)
- **Role**: Scrum Master & Full-Stack Developer (Team of 4)
- **Domain**: Collaborative Regional E-Commerce Web Application
- **Stack**: Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, Vanilla JavaScript, CSS3, Git/GitHub, Scrum
- **Summary**: Coordinated sprint ceremonies and team Git workflows as Scrum Master while developing dynamic product views, custom cart events in Vanilla JavaScript, and Spring Boot/MySQL REST endpoints.

### 5. Lulú & Co (E-Commerce Storefront & Catalog Experience)
- **Domain**: Modern Retail & Brand E-Commerce Web Application
- **Stack**: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Summary**: Responsive e-commerce storefront focused on clean visual hierarchy, product discovery, and streamlined checkout flows.
